about.title: More Than Marketing. We Build Connections.
about.intro: From emerging businesses and entrepreneurs to global brands and community organisations, we help our clients communicate with confidence and connect with the right people.
description: You Or Me Innovations (YOM) is a digital marketing, PR and brand-growth company built around one simple idea: successful brands connect with people.
We bring together strategy, creativity, technology and community insight to help businesses tell their stories, strengthen their visibility and reach new audiences.
Our particular strength is connecting brands with African, Caribbean, diaspora and local communities while helping ambitious businesses build a presence that can grow beyond their immediate market.
We do not just create campaigns. We help create connections that lead to opportunity, growth and impact.
